draft.subject: Embedded and Low Level Software Engineering Openings | Justin Mascarenhas
draft.body:
I am Justin Mascarenhas. I have an M.S. in Computer Engineering from Rochester Institute of Technology. I am writing about the embedded and low level software engineering openings at Interclypse. The posting leads with mentorship and with the long term health of the people doing the work rather than a checklist of tools, and that is why I wanted to write to you directly instead of only applying.

My work has been embedded and systems software. I built monitoring firmware for a microcontroller at the bare metal level that held a steady update rate inside a very small memory footprint. For my graduate capstone I built a voice controlled robotic arm as a distributed system, then worked through every integration failure between its layers until it picked reliably on every attempt. I ran the Linux side as a managed service, so it recovered on its own.

I would appreciate the opportunity to discuss the role further, if your time allows. I can share my resume if that would be helpful.
draft.hook_used: Posting is framed around mentorship and long term career health, a leadership level framing rather than an engineering req
